Subject: Need help with a tenancy eviction case

Hello, my name is Nikhil Sandhu. I am a 26-year-old nurse living in Mysuru. I have a tenancy problem with Deepak More involving Rs. 70,000 in rent, and the tenant has sublet the flat without permission. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 78986 54777 or email nikhil.sandhu@example.in.
